reason: The extraction head looks like the direct first step toward bringing water out of the surveyed bore.
expectation: I expect it to begin extracting water from the ice, though it may need a hose and treatment afterward.

alternatives.reason: The foil and felt might make insulation for the water line, but extraction seems like the more immediate step.

effect: The sealed well has produced cloudy water, so the next step is to connect it to the treatment line.
reaction: The closed melt pocket is a satisfying, physically clear start.
reason: The hose should carry water from the well toward treatment.
expectation: I expect a connected water line, though it may still need insulation or a processor connection.

alternatives.reason: Insulation may be useful, but connecting the water source seems more immediate.

effect: The hose already connects the well to the processor, and the strainer is catching grit; treatment is the next step.
reaction: The upstream strainer makes the water system feel practical and clear.
reason: Using the connected line at the processor directly advances the treatment goal.
expectation: I expect the processor to treat the gritty meltwater, though further steps may be needed before it is usable.

alternatives.reason: The foil and felt may make useful insulation, but treatment is the immediate goal.

effect: Treatment produced drinking water, and the remaining goal is to protect the exterior run.
reaction: The first nearly tasteless cup is a nice concrete payoff.
reason: This is the only offered action, and the foil and felt seem suited to insulating the exterior line.
expectation: I expect an insulating wrap or blanket that can help protect the water line.

effect: The foil and felt made reflective insulation, ready to protect the well line.
reaction: The result is straightforward, with no further explanation.
reason: This is the only offered action and directly addresses protection of the exterior run.
expectation: I expect the insulation to wrap the line and reduce heat loss.

effect: The exterior line is protected, completing the chapter; the result clarifies that insulation slows heat loss while heat tracing supplies heat.
reaction: The distinction between insulation and active heating is a satisfying, useful detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Insulating the heat-traced hose was the most worthwhile: the accessible couplings and explanation of heat loss made the construction feel practical.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making reflective insulation was the least engaging moment: it was the only offered action and its result added no explanation until the next step.

surprise.text: The hose was already connected to the processor when the well line was made, and the upstream strainer was catching grit before treatment.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt distinctly arbitrary; the offered actions followed a clear water-treatment and protection sequence, although the last two were the only available actions.

continue.text: Yes. The practical water-system details and the prospect of seeing the food programme develop would make me curious to continue, though the decisions here were mostly straightforward.
